materiality.rationale: Hyperscaler silicon strategy made concrete: inference-first NUMA chiplets, HBM4 density, and superpod networking sized for agentic decode. Reader learns the architectural bets (data movement over raw FLOPs) and the permanent caveat (unnamed GPU baseline, internal-only, 2027 production). Tradeoff: efficiency claims vs unverifiability. [r7 substantive view; no selection implied.]
